sections.name: Page 1
sections.text:
BioIntel AI Reference Research Report
Demonstration content only - not experimental evidence
Abstract
This reference report demonstrates PDF extraction, table recovery, scientific entity recognition, document search
and evidence bridging. It discusses PTGS2, ADORA2A, SIRT1 and PIK3CA with illustrative IC50, Ki and EC50
measurements.
Methods
Ten reference compounds were assessed in a simulated biochemical screening workflow. Values are illustrative
and are included only to populate the BioIntel AI demonstration workspace.
Compound Target Endpoint Value (nM) Review
Aspirin reference PTGS2 IC50 125 Reviewed
Caffeine reference ADORA2A Ki 820 Reviewed
Adenosine reference ADORA2A Ki 32 Reviewed
Warfarin reference VKORC1 IC50 18 Reviewed
Quercetin reference PIK3CA IC50 950 Reviewed

sections.name: Page 2
sections.text:
Results and Interpretation
The smallest illustrative value was 18 nM for VKORC1. The ADORA2A examples demonstrate multiple
compounds and support cross-document target comparison. These results must not be used for clinical or
laboratory conclusions.
Activity Summary
Metric Value
Reference compounds 10
Targets 7
Reviewed records 6
Pending records 4
Median activity 790 nM
Limitations
The dataset is synthetic/reference-only. No wet-lab validation, clinical interpretation or scientific release is
permitted.
